tasks.title: Setup project boilerplate and database connection
tasks.description:
read backend-developer.agent.md

Setup the initial project structure with:
- Express/NestJS boilerplate
- PostgreSQL connection via TypeORM
- Environment configuration (.env)
- Base error handling middleware
- Health check endpoint at GET /health
- Project folder structure as per agent architecture

tasks.title: Implement user authentication endpoints
tasks.description:
read backend-developer.agent.md

Build the authentication system:
- POST /auth/register — register new user (email, password, name)
- POST /auth/login — login with email/password, return JWT
- POST /auth/refresh — refresh expired token
- GET /auth/me — get current user profile (protected)
- Password hashing with bcrypt
- JWT token generation and validation
- Input validation on all endpoints
